Poor unwed mother having no means of livelihood or support from family of SC community. Poor unwed mother having no means of livelihood or support from family of other community. Poor divorcee or Desertee from ST community. Poor divorcee or Desertee from SC community. Poor divorcee or Desertee from Other community.
If two or more candidates belong to the same community
priority is decided by: (i) Rangamatia GP
and (iv) Elder candidate i.e. higher date of birth.
how_to_apply: Log on to the official website at www.mayurbhanj.odisha.gov.in to download the prescribed application form.
Fill out the application form in block letters only.
Affix a recent passport-size coloured photograph on the designated space on the application form.
Attach self-attested Xerox copies of all required supporting documents.
Submit the completed application form directly by hand to the Office of the Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Sansole on any working day from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on or before 31/10/2026.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted directly to the Office of the Principal within the specified working hours up to 31/10/2026. The engagement is purely on a contract/honorarium basis. Candidates engaged as Cook-cum-Helpers have no right to claim regularisation or absorption/appointment as regular employees under the State Government. Services will be terminated upon attaining the age of 60 years or if found unfit for health or disability reasons.

content_sections.heading: OAV Sansole Cook cum Helper Overview
OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Cook-cum-Helper post under Mukhyamantri Poshan Yojona at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Sansole.

content_sections.heading: OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Must be a female candidate. Medically fit and free from any contagious disease.

rows.qualification_required: Not specified in the notification (Educational qualification certificate required to be attached)

content_sections.heading: OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper Age Limit
content_sections.text: The candidate must be more than 18 years old and less than 60 years old. The notification does not specify a fixed age cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper Salary
content_sections.text: The honorarium is paid during school working days and is credited directly to the account of the CCH from the State Project Management Unit (MDM), School & Mass Education Department, Odisha.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 3,000/- per month (or rate fixed from time to time by Govt.)

content_sections.heading: OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is made through a Committee authorised by the Vidyalaya Management and Development Committee (VMDC). Priority is determined by community category and residential location in the following order: Destitute women from ST community. Destitute women from SC community. Destitute women from other community. Poor unwed mother having no means of livelihood or support from family of ST community. Poor unwed mother having no means of livelihood or support from family of SC community. Poor unwed mother having no means of livelihood or support from family of other community. Poor divorcee or Desertee from ST community. Poor divorcee or Desertee from SC community. Poor divorcee or Desertee from Other community. If two or more candidates belong to the same community, priority is decided by: (i) Rangamatia GP, (ii) Shamakhunta Block, (iii) Mayurbhanj District, and (iv) Elder candidate i.e. higher date of birth.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper
content_sections.text: Log on to the official website at www.mayurbhanj.odisha.gov.in to download the prescribed application form. Fill out the application form in block letters only. Affix a recent passport-size coloured photograph on the designated space on the application form. Attach self-attested Xerox copies of all required supporting documents. Submit the completed application form directly by hand to the Office of the Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Sansole on any working day from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on or before 31/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Xerox copy of Educational Qualification certificate Xerox copy of Caste Certificate Xerox copy of Residential Certificate Proof of Destitute / Widow / Unwed Mother / Divorce / Desertee Xerox copy of Voter ID and Aadhaar Card Xerox copy of Medical Fitness Certificate One passport-size photograph pasted on the application form

content_sections.heading: OAV Sansole Cook-cum-Helper Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted directly to the Office of the Principal within the specified working hours up to 31/10/2026. The engagement is purely on a contract/honorarium basis. Candidates engaged as Cook-cum-Helpers have no right to claim regularisation or absorption/appointment as regular employees under the State Government. Services will be terminated upon attaining the age of 60 years or if found unfit for health or disability reasons.
